note: What the host provides to a plugin without the plugin declaring it. Two sources, both read from data: the kernel's own package tree (core/deepseek-harness/packages/** and vendor/*, enumerated by scripts/compose-profile-rows.mjs kernelRoster) and this client baseline, which is the module table the web shell preloads (see packages/client/web/src/platform.ts in the kernel). plugins/build.mjs reads clientBaseline from this file so there is one copy of the list, not a constant beside a capture.
